title: EDGE-A002 1 on 1 checking drill F vs D
source_asset: SOURCE_ASSETS/INTAKE-00002__1 on 1 checking drill F vs D.jpg
source_text: Forwards line up against side boards at blue line. Defensemen line up in slot. On the whistle, D-Man executes transition element, pivoting at hash marks to go back and retrieve a puck that coach dumped in corner. Forward skates a tight figure 8 at blue line-pursues D-Man retrieving the dump-in. D-Man has to skate puck out of zone (not shooting it out, but carrying the puck out) against resistance of forechecker.
game_problem: Retrieve and exit the zone under forecheck pressure
representative_information: Dump-in, forechecker pressure, gap/route to exit
player_decisions: D reads pressure and chooses how to carry the puck out; F angles/pursues
space_organization: Defensive zone; F starts at side boards/blue line; D starts in slot
coach_notes: Preserve source sequence. Emphasize shoulder checks before retrieval and protecting the puck while finding an exit lane.

title: EDGE-A009 1-1 2-1 3-2 Continuous Drill FULL
source_text: D in middle, Fs with pucks in corners. F takes off and D plays 1-1. Same F curls up boards as next F drops puck for them and they play 2-1 going other way. title: EDGE-A110 1-1 Battle - 3 loose puck drill HALF
source_asset: SOURCE_ASSETS/INTAKE-00023__1-1 Battle - 3 loose puck drill HALF.jpg
source_text: Image instructions: divide ice into two sections; play simultaneously. Coach dumps first puck in designated area. First player in each line races to gain possession and protect puck for 15 seconds; second puck is dumped, same players race to retain possession another 15 seconds; third puck is dumped, players race to gain possession and move to take a shot on net; drill ends after shot.
game_problem: Repeatedly win and protect loose pucks, then convert the final possession into a shot.
representative_information: Successive coach-dumped loose pucks, opponent pressure, boundary/section and net on final puck.
player_decisions: Race/recover puck, use body position to protect for timed intervals, re-engage on new loose puck, then attack net on third possession.
space_organization: Half-ice divided into two simultaneous sections; two competing players per section; three successive puck drops, first two 15-second possession battles, third ends in shot.
goalie: Goalie/net used for final shot; diagram shows goalie.
coach_notes: Keep the three-puck progression and timed protection bouts. Coach controls puck location to force fresh retrieval/positioning battles.
